data: Does the solid black line ever dip below 27%?

The solid black line represents female employment numbers over time. The y-axis shows the percentage of females employed, ranging from 27% to 35%. The x-axis represents years from 1950 to 1990. The line fluctuates but remains above 27% throughout the entire period shown in the graph. Therefore, the solid black line never dips below 27%.
